explanation: scripts/build_query_index.mts becomes the write adapter of src/data/queryWire.ts: its private DatasetMeta, DatasetSummary, DiscoverySummary, TrackEntry, ExprRow, track-pathway row and volcano types, its isLowPower copy, cardGlobalName and every hand-spelled HX_QUERY_* name and shard path are gone, rows are built by the shared encoders and the --check path reads a typed QueryManifest instead of as-unknown casts. A before/after build over the restored bundles produced build 1cpqpf5dmmhsv with all 1675 files byte-identical. CONTEXT.md gains the query-wire module bullet.
